trial_court: Metropolitan Magistrate, Dwarka Courts, New Delhi (Criminal Complaint No.:43280/2019)
case_name: Pooja Finlease Ltd vs Rajnish Karki
facts_of_case: Pooja Finlease Ltd filed a complaint against Rajnish Karki for cheque bounce under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881. The complainant alleged that the accused had taken loans from them and failed to repay the loan amount.

legal_principles.principle: Once the signature(s) of an accused on a cheque/negotiable instrument are established, then the 'reverse onus' clause becomes operative.
legal_principles.held: The Statute mandates that once the signature(s) of an accused on the cheque/negotiable instrument are established, then the 'reverse onus' clause become operative.
cited_cases: M/S Kalamani Tex vs P. Balasubramanian, Criminal Appeal No. 123 of 2021

legal_principles.principle: A cheque issued as security pursuant to a financial transaction cannot be considered as a worthless piece of paper.
legal_principles.held: Merely because a cheque has been issued for only security purpose will not absolve the accused from the liability u/s. 138 NI Act.
cited_cases: Sampelly Satyanarayana Rao v. Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Ltd., (2016) 10 SCC 458
Sripati Singh vs. State of Jharkhand & Anr., 2021 SCC OnLine SC 1002
Sunil Todi vs. State of Gujarat & Anr., 2021 SCC OnLine SC 1174

legal_principles.principle: The court can raise a presumption under Section 118(a) r/w Section 139 of the NI Act that a cheque was issued by an accused to a complainant in discharge of legally enforceable debt or liability.
legal_principles.held: This court raises presumption under section 118(a) r/w section 139 of NI Act that the cheque in question were issued by the accused to the complainant in discharge of legally enforceable debt or liability and it is now on the accused to raise a probable defence and to prove his case on the basis of preponderance of probabilities.
cited_cases: K. Bhaskaran vs. Sankaran Vaidhyan Balan, [1999(4) RCR (Criminal) 309]

outcome.final_order: The accused was convicted for cheque bounce.

use_for_drafting: drafting a complaint under section 138 NIA
defending an accused in a cheque bounce case
advising on the prescription period for a demand notice
